intro: NMIMS Mumbai fees for the MBA are ₹13.50 lakh a year, as per NMIMS's official NMAT 2026 admission handout, which puts the two-year programme at roughly ₹27 lakh if the second-year fee stays the same. Welingkar Mumbai's PGDM lists tuition of ₹7 lakh a year in its 2026-28 brochure.

Both institutes are in {{cityA}}. This page compares their MBA / PGDM fees, placements, admission routes and campus, using official pages and our database checked in {{year}}. NMIMS Mumbai holds NIRF 2025 #24 on our records, and Welingkar Mumbai holds NIRF 2025 #75.

sections.heading: NMIMS Mumbai MBA fees 2026: programme-wise
paragraphs: NMIMS (SVKM's NMIMS, deemed to be university) charges different fees for each MBA programme and campus. The table below is copied from the fee section of the official NMAT 2026 admission handout. These are first-year, per-annum fees; NMIMS says the fee for the following year will be given in the offer letter.

table.caption: NMIMS MBA fees per annum, NMAT 2026 admission handout (nmat.nmims.edu)
rows: MBA Business Analytics / MBA Digital Transformation

bullets: NMIMS application fee: ₹3,000 (online only), in addition to the NMAT by GMAC registration fee.
Eligibility for the Mumbai MBA: a bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate.
Selection: NMAT score, then a competency test and/or personal interview; NMIMS says there is no management quota for its MBA programmes.
Hostel and living costs in Mumbai are extra and are not part of the fee above.

sections.heading: NMIMS Mumbai vs Welingkar Mumbai for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose NMIMS Mumbai if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #24, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Mumbai.
Choose Welingkar Mumbai if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #75, and a recorded fee of ₹5.5 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Mumbai.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
NMIMS Mumbai: ₹13.50 lakh per year for the flagship MBA (official NMAT 2026 handout); the second-year fee is confirmed in the offer letter.
Welingkar's official PGDM 2026-28 brochure lists tuition of ₹7 lakh a year, marked as subject to change.
Our recorded figure for Welingkar Mumbai is ₹5.5 lakh on PGDM E-Biz. Check it against the official notice before you decide.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: NMIMS Mumbai's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹28 LPA on MBA- Pharmaceutical Management Pharmaceutical Management. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Welingkar Mumbai here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: NMIMS Mumbai is listed on our records with NMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

Welingkar Mumbai is listed on our records with ATMA, CAT, MAH MBA CET, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If ranks and the wider recruiter mix matter most, NMIMS Mumbai is the stronger recorded option on this page, with NIRF 2025 #24 against NIRF 2025 #75.

On official fees, NMIMS Mumbai's MBA (₹13.50 lakh a year) costs almost double Welingkar Mumbai's PGDM tuition (₹7 lakh a year), so decide whether the rank and placement gap is worth that difference for you.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: What are NMIMS Mumbai fees for the MBA?
faqs.answer: The official NMAT 2026 admission handout lists ₹13,50,000 per year for the MBA at NMIMS Mumbai, ₹12,75,000 for MBA HR and ₹11,50,000 for MBA Business Analytics or Digital Transformation. The second-year fee is stated in the offer letter, and hostel costs are extra.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, NMIMS Mumbai or Welingkar Mumbai?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. NMIMS Mumbai and Welingkar Mumbai differ in more than one way: NMIMS Mumbai holds NIRF 2025 #24 on our records, while Welingkar Mumbai holds NIRF 2025 #75.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for NMIMS Mumbai vs Welingkar Mumbai?
faqs.answer: NMIMS's official NMAT 2026 admission handout lists the Mumbai MBA at ₹13.50 lakh per annum for 2026-28, and says the 2027-28 year will be intimated in the offer letter; Welingkar's official PGDM 2026-28 brochure lists tuition of ₹7 lakh a year, marked as subject to.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for NMIMS Mumbai and Welingkar Mumbai?
faqs.answer: NMIMS Mumbai's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹28 LPA on MBA- Pharmaceutical Management Pharmaceutical Management. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do NMIMS Mumbai and Welingkar Mumbai accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list NMAT for NMIMS Mumbai, and ATMA, CAT, MAH MBA CET, XAT for Welingkar Mumbai. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are NMIMS Mumbai and Welingkar Mumbai in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
